by_category:
by_category
	| totals expenses result |
	totals := Dictionary new.
	expenses := state at: 'expenses' ifAbsent: [ #() ].
	expenses do: [ :expense |
		| category |
		category := expense at: 'category'.
		totals at: category put: ((totals at: category ifAbsent: [ 0 ]) + (((expense at: 'amount') * 100) rounded)) ].
	result := Dictionary new.
	totals keysAndValuesDo: [ :category :cents | result at: category put: cents / 100 ].
	^ result
total:
total
	| expenses cents |
	expenses := state at: 'expenses' ifAbsent: [ #() ].
	cents := expenses inject: 0 into: [ :sum :expense | sum + (((expense at: 'amount') * 100) rounded) ].
	^ cents / 100
top_category:
top_category
	| spent best bestCents |
	spent := self by_category.
	spent isEmpty ifTrue: [ ^ nil ].
	best := nil.
	bestCents := nil.
	spent keys asSortedCollection do: [ :category |
		| cents |
		cents := ((spent at: category) * 100) rounded.
		(bestCents isNil or: [ cents > bestCents ])
			ifTrue: [ best := category. bestCents := cents ] ].
	^ best
over_budget:
over_budget
	| spent budgets |
	spent := self by_category.
	budgets := state at: 'budgets' ifAbsent: [ Dictionary new ].
	^ ((budgets keys select: [ :category |
			(((spent at: category ifAbsent: [ 0 ]) * 100) rounded)
				> (((budgets at: category) * 100) rounded) ]) asSortedCollection) asArray
add_expense:
add_expense: amount category: category
	| expense expenses |
	amount isNumber ifFalse: [ self error: 'amount must be a number' ].
	amount > 0 ifFalse: [ self error: 'amount must be greater than zero' ].
	(category isString and: [ category isEmpty not ])
		ifFalse: [ self error: 'category is required' ].
	expense := Dictionary new
		at: 'amount' put: amount;
		at: 'category' put: category;
		yourself.
	expenses := state at: 'expenses' ifAbsentPut: [ OrderedCollection new ].
	expenses add: expense.
	^ expenses size

add_expense: amount category: category note: note
	| expense expenses |
	amount isNumber ifFalse: [ self error: 'amount must be a number' ].
	amount > 0 ifFalse: [ self error: 'amount must be greater than zero' ].
	(category isString and: [ category isEmpty not ])
		ifFalse: [ self error: 'category is required' ].
	note isString ifFalse: [ self error: 'breaks expenses-shape' ].
	expense := Dictionary new
		at: 'amount' put: amount;
		at: 'category' put: category;
		at: 'note' put: note;
		yourself.
	expenses := state at: 'expenses' ifAbsentPut: [ OrderedCollection new ].
	expenses add: expense.
	^ expenses size
set_budget:
set_budget: category amount: amount
	amount isNumber ifFalse: [ self error: 'amount must be a number' ].
	(category isString and: [ category isEmpty not ])
		ifFalse: [ self error: 'category is required' ].
	(state at: 'budgets' ifAbsentPut: [ Dictionary new ]) at: category put: amount.
	^ amount
